subject: Auto Body Repairs and Spray Painting

subStrands.name: Safety Rules, Regulations and Accident Prevention

objectives.description: Definition of safety rules and regulations in auto body repairs and spray painting.
List of rules and regulations and their importance.
Identification of safety tools and equipment/machines for auto body repairs.
Auto body dressing code: personal protective equipment (nose mask, goggles, boots, ear defender, etc).
Sources of accident (human factors, machinery/equipment and workshop keeping) and their preventions.

Factory acts on safety rules and regulations: 1984 amended resource conservation recovery act, environmental protection agency regulations and hazardous waste collection and recycling (solvent recovery system).

subStrands.name: Hand Tools, Power Tools, Spray Equipment and Maintenance

objectives.description: Types of hand tools (hammers, dollies, spanner, files, ratchets, body spoons, etc) and their uses.
Types and uses of power tools and equipment/machines (drilling machine, body jack, sanders, air compressor, shaping machines, cutting machine, etc).
Advantages and disadvantages of machines; uses of machines and safety precautions.
Spray painting tools and equipment (scrapers, brushes, funnels, paint pots, spray gun, spray body filters, air compressor, oven, spray boot, etc).
Definition of maintenance and types — predictive, preventive and corrective; manufacturer's maintenance guide; maintenance of tools and equipment.

subStrands.name: Body Repair Materials, Metals and Paints

objectives.description: Types of body filler: plastic filler, fibreglass fillers, body solder (30/70 and 40/60).
Types of body abrasives e.g. sand papers (wet and dry), sanding disc.
Types of sealers e.g. rubber sealers, seam sealers, undercoating, etc.
Types of metals used in auto body; rivet pins e.g. pop and solid rivets.
Types of paints — enamel paints and lacquers; under coats: surface primer, putty/body filler, sealers; top coats: lacquers and enamel paints.
Manufacturers paint guide: paint formula, paint mixing equipment, custom-mix base colours, paint labels, colour charts.
Ferrous and non-ferrous metals — mild steel, cast iron, aluminium, brass, etc; properties of metals — fusibility, malleability, ductility, weldability, etc; uses of metals on auto bodies.
Definition of heat treatment; types and process of heat treatment e.g. hardening, annealing, normalizing, case-hardening and tempering; importance of heat treatment.
Definition of oxy-acetylene welding; safety precautions; oxy-acetylene welding equipment.
Types of oxy-acetylene gas used e.g. high and low pressure system; installations of welding equipment; welding nozzles.
Defects of oxy-acetylene welding — slag inclusion, porosity, crack, lack of penetration, etc and their remedies.

subStrands.name: Minor and Major Body Repair, Aluminium and Plastic Repair

objectives.description: Types of auto body: integral body; composite body.

Basic methods of straightening auto body: aligning the metal with power jack, pulling the metal with sledge hammer, using pro-bar, pulling the metal with pull taps, heat-shrinking the metal to bring it back to its original shape.
Tools used in minor repairs — hammers, hand dollies, spoons, spanners, screw drivers, etc.
Major body sections e.g. front engine compartment, passenger section, rear section; basic alignment principle; quarter panel cutting; light weight panels; damaged vehicle alignment.
Steps involved in aluminium panel repair; repair and alignment of damaged aluminium panel; aluminium deck lid repair.
Plastic repairs: precautions while working with plastics; types of plastic resins (thermosetting and thermoplastic); repair of plastic parts by melting; introduction to glass fibre panel repair.

subStrands.name: Spray Gun, Surface Preparation, Paint Types and Workshop Business

objectives.description: Spray gun types: pressure feed gun, siphon and gravity gun; spray gun parts — air cap, fluid needle, air valve, trigger gun, body, cup, etc; precautions in the use of spray gun; manufacturer's maintenance guide.
Surface preparation for spray painting.
Types of paints used on auto bodies: cellulose synthetic paint, enamel paint, acrylic, metallic paints, etc; importance of manufacturer's paint code; special paints and their importance.
Metallic paint: variable agents (flakes and pigments); metallic spray techniques (wet and dry spray).
Auto body workshop business: factors to consider in locating auto body repair shop — capital, accessibility, land, etc; list of tools and equipment.
